thread:
Jordan: Quick reminder — changelog cutoff for v2.8.0 is today at 18:00 PT. Please add your entry to the release-notes folder or include it in the PR description. release-bot will run a linter at 18:05 and any malformed entries will be rejected. Also remember to bump the package version on merge.

Sam: Copy — can someone paste the exact entry shape we check for? I always mix up the order.

Jordan: Minimal shape we enforce: one-line imperative summary, category (fix/feature/ops), area/team in parens, and a short test note. Bullet must start with `- `. Example: 

```
- Improve inference batching heuristics (feature, eng-runtime) — reduces token cost by ~12% on long-tail requests. Test: run smoke_evals/batching.yml and confirm p95 latency < 120ms.
```

Maya: Also callout: if it’s a breaking change, prefix with `BREAKING:` in the same line and add a short migration note. release-bot checks for the `BREAKING:` token.

Sam: Thanks. Does the linter also check for a linked PR/issue?

Jordan: It flags missing PR/issue links in the body as a warning but doesn't block. The blocker rules are malformed bullets, missing category, or no test note.

Sam: Who's owning the backports/cherrypicks to release/2.8? We need runtime + infra cherry-picks before cutoff.

Amit: I can take the runtime cherrypicks. Tag me @Amit in the PR and I’ll queue them. I won’t be able to handle infra.

Maya: I’ll take infra. @Amit please ping me if any merge conflicts need manual resolution.

Jordan: Thanks both. If either of you get blocked, @release-manager will coordinate hotfix backports.

Charlie: Heads up — we’re doing a short freeze window on main from 18:00–18:10 PT to ensure the release branch cut and avoid accidental large merges. Avoid merging big refactors in that window.

Sam: One small question: where do we put the version bump? In the release PR or the component PR?

Jordan: For this release we prefer the component PR to include the version bump when it's a single-package change. For cross-repo releases we do a dedicated release PR that bumps the top-level manifest. If in doubt, include the bump in the merge commit and call it out in the changelog entry.

Maya: Practical tip — use the template link (https://redwood.internal/release-notes/template.md). It has the exact lint rules and examples.

Sam: OK filing my entry now.

release-bot: FYI: lint job scheduled for 1781234830. Current queue length: 12 entries. Will post detailed failures at completion. :robot_face:

Jordan: TL;DR: add a `- ` bullet following the template, include category and team, add a short test note, cherry-pick to release/2.8 if needed, and ping @Amit or @Maya for backports. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
